Title: Heaven's Gate vs Charigger the Axe

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
A has Ossian in play and a vampire with , B has a vampire with Charigger, The Axe. Ossian burns in combat. Can A play Heaven's Gate before Charigger's ability triggers?

1. It depends on who's acting (Sequencing)
2. No, Charigger's ability always takes precedence

Relevant rulings:  [ANK 20210627]  [LSJ 20071003]

Note that it's clear that both (as replacement effects) have precedence over effects that depend on the minion burning (eg. Kherebutu and other mummies)

Heaven's Gate

Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire not involved in the combat.
Prevent 1 damage to an ally in combat.
Only usable if an ally would be burned in combat. Instead, they gain 1 life if they have no life, and they cannot enter (or be involved in) combat, perform actions, or block this turn; end combat.
As  above, but add 2 life if they have no life, not to exceed their starting life.

Charigger, The Axe

Unique wraith with 1 life.
This Giovanni gets +1 stealth when hunting. If a minion controlled by your prey would be burned, instead remove that burning minion from the game and put 1 soul counter on Charigger. This Giovanni gets +1 bleed for each soul counter on Charigger.

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
It should first depend on the impulse and second on the chosen sequencing.

I compare it with the question "Who is allowed to announce a block ignoring the regular restrictions first". It is not Anneke by default, it is the player who gets the impulse first.
Thus if player A were acting/had the impulse he could play "Heaven's Gate" before the effect of "Charigger, The Axe", and if player B were acting/had the impulse then the effect of "Charigger, The Axe" would kick in first.

And a player controlling both a Vampire with Obeah and "Charigger, The Axe" should be allowed to choose if he wished to play "Heaven's Gate" before the effect of "Charigger, The Axe" kicks in.
